🔄 Content updated (Published: August 7, 2026 / Previously posted: May 1, 2026)
Main changes: Bidding application period postponed from May 22 – June 5, 2026 to August 21 – September 3, 2026. Bidding date moved from June 19 to September 11. Properties divided into 3 groups (A, B, C) allowing separate bidding for each group or combined bidding for all three.

General competitive bidding for city-owned land will be held.

【Properties for Sale】
Property A (Yamate-machi, 3 plots of farmland, total 242.24 m²) Minimum sale price ¥19.7 million, Bid security deposit ¥2.955 million
Property B (Yamate-machi, 2 residential plots, total 625.78 m²) Minimum sale price ¥46.9 million, Bid security deposit ¥7.035 million
Property C (Yamate-machi, 1 residential plot, 171.97 m²) Minimum sale price ¥18.4 million, Bid security deposit ¥2.76 million
Combined sale (A + B + C, total 1,039.99 m²) Minimum sale price ¥68 million, Bid security deposit ¥10.2 million

Zoning: First-class residential area. If combined bidding applications are received and no separate bidding applications are received, combined bidding will take priority.

【Bidding Schedule】
Application period: August 21 (Friday) – September 3 (Thursday), 2026, 9:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.
Bidding date and time: September 11 (Friday), 2026, 2:00 p.m.
Bidding venue: Bidding Room, 2nd Floor, Hanno City Hall Main Building

Application documents are listed in the general competitive bidding notice.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/shisankeieika/7334.html
summary: ℹ️ City land sale (general competitive bidding)
